scripts.build: bun build src/server.ts --outdir dist --target bun && bun -e "import { cp } from 'node:fs/promises'; await cp('src/db/migrations', 'dist/migrations', { recursive: true });"
scripts.test:load: bun run build && bun test tests/load/metrics.test.ts && bun tests/load/runner.ts
scripts.test: bun test src/modules/play tests/unit src/app.test.ts src/modules/auth/*.test.ts src/modules/claims/*.test.ts src/modules/operations/*.test.ts src/modules/live/*.test.ts src/modules/recovery/*.test.ts src/shared/email/*.test.ts src/realtime/*.test.ts tests/operations/*.test.ts tests/restore/guards.test.ts tests/security/rate-limit.test.ts
scripts.test:security: bun test --parallel=1 tests/security tests/unit/logger-security.test.ts src/shared/email/email.service.test.ts tests/integration/auth.test.ts tests/integration/errors.test.ts tests/integration/import.test.ts tests/integration/participant.test.ts tests/integration/ticket.test.ts tests/integration/mark-persistence.test.ts tests/integration/draw-engine.test.ts tests/integration/claim-submission.test.ts tests/integration/live-display.test.ts tests/integration/operations.test.ts tests/integration/recovery.test.ts tests/integration/question.test.ts tests/integration/round-operation.test.ts tests/integration/event.test.ts tests/integration/admin.test.ts src/modules/live/live.service.test.ts src/modules/operations/operations.test.ts src/realtime/events.test.ts src/realtime/realtime.routes.test.ts
